attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The refactor removes the protected virtual ShapeBuildingAsync extension point from the widely-used BaseShapeTagHelper and drops the Title/DisplayType attribute handling from UserDisplayNameTagHelper, which can silently break tooltip rendering across multiple built-in admin views and any downstream module that extended this shared tag helper."}

reason: The refactor removes the protected virtual ShapeBuildingAsync extension point from the widely-used BaseShapeTagHelper and drops the Title/DisplayType attribute handling from UserDisplayNameTagHelper, which can silently break tooltip rendering across multiple built-in admin views and any downstream module that extended this shared tag helper.
